name: usage-meter
description: Engine-measured context and quota line for the model each turn, plus configurable threshold toasts

toasts.title: Threshold toasts
toasts.description: Show a toast when context or quota crosses a band. The model-facing line is always sent.

context_toasts.title: Context toasts
context_toasts.description: Items separated by ||, each '<band %>: <message>'. Bands 1-100, ascending. Placeholders: {pct} {band}.
context_toasts.default: 50: ⚠ Context {pct}% — consider /compact after this task || 75: ⚠ Context {pct}% — /compact or start a new session soon || 90: ⚠ Context {pct}% — near the limit, /compact now

quota_toasts.title: Quota toasts
quota_toasts.description: Items separated by ||, each '<band %>: <message>', applied to every rate-limit window. Bands 1-100, ascending. Placeholders: {pct} {band} {window} {reset}.
quota_toasts.default: 80: ⚠ Claude {window} usage {pct}% — pace your usage (reset: {reset}) || 95: ⚠ Claude {window} usage {pct}% — nearly used up (reset: {reset})
